basic_details.job_title: OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out - Apply Online for 100 Diploma, Graduate and ITI Apprentice Posts
basic_details.post_name: Degree Engineering Apprentice, Degree Non-Engineering Apprentice, Diploma Technician Apprentice, ITI Trade Apprentice
basic_details.job_location: Various OPTCL units and offices across Odisha
basic_details.application_mode: Online (via NATS/NAPS portal, then OPTCL website)
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL), a state-owned power utility engaged in the transmission of electricity in Odisha, invites applications from young and meritorious aspirants for engagement as Degree (Engineering and Non-Engineering), Diploma, and Trade (ITI) Apprentices for a period of one year, under the Apprentices Act, 1961 (as amended in 1961, 1973, and 2014). Selection is made on the basis of academic merit, written test, or interview, as required for the respective discipline. Register for Job Alerts

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned anywhere in this notification.

age_limit.details: The candidate should not be less than 18 years of age as on 1 August 2026. No maximum age limit is specified in the notification. | Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

qualification.details: The prescribed qualification must be from a recognised Board/Council/University/Institute, completed as a regular full-time course. As noted in the notification, for Non-Engineering Apprentices, graduation in non-engineering disciplines such as BA, B.Sc, B.Com, or BBA, or equivalent, shall be preferred. | Only Indian nationals belonging to the state of Odisha are eligible to apply. Candidates must have the minimum physical standard prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and amendments thereof. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, or who have job experience of one year or more, are not eligible to apply. Candidates who are currently appearing for (i.e., have not yet passed) the requisite essential qualifying examination are not eligible to apply. Candidates must hold the passing certificate or final year marksheet of the required qualification as on 1 July 2026. The gap between the date of joining the Apprenticeship Training and the date of passing the essential qualifying examination must not be more than 3 years, and the qualifying examination must have been passed during Academic Year 2023–24, 2024–25, or 2025–26. Candidates must be registered on the NAPS/NATS portal, and their bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of the stipend.
qualification.required_degree: BE/B.Tech in Electrical / Electrical & Electronics Engineering or equivalent

salary_details.details: As per the notification, OPTCL will pay 50% of the stipend to Degree Engineering Apprentices, Diploma Technician Apprentices, and Degree Non-Engineering Apprentices, with the remaining 50% paid by the Board of Apprenticeship Training (referred to as BOPT in the notification) through DBT. The funding split for the ITI Trade Apprentice stipend is not separately specified in the document. Apprentices are entitled to the stipend from the start of the online contract date, subject to satisfactory performance during the training period.

selection_process: Selection will be made on the basis of academic merit

as required for the respective discipline. The notification does not specify a fixed common formula for all disciplines; the exact mode of selection applied may vary by discipline. Key points on the process:

OPTCL follows a transparent and merit-based apprenticeship selection process. No TA/DA or other expenses will be paid to candidates for attending document verification or interview. At any stage of the selection process
if a candidate is found to have furnished false or incorrect information
the candidature or engagement is liable to be cancelled. The decision of the Management of OPTCL is final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility
acceptance or rejection of the application
and cancellation of the selection process (in part or full). No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Filling up of the seats is solely at the discretion of OPTCL Management
based on the suitability of candidates; no claim will be entertained if some seats remain unfilled due to unsuitability or an insufficient number of candidates.

The period of apprenticeship training is one year (12 months). The training period commences from the online contract date of the Apprenticeship Training and continues for one year. It is not obligatory for OPTCL to offer employment to any apprentice who has completed their apprenticeship

nor can an apprentice claim a right to employment on the ground of having completed the Apprenticeship Training. Training will be provided at different units and offices of OPTCL across Odisha; no accommodation or allowance in lieu of accommodation will be provided at the training location
and apprentices must strictly follow safety rules at their place of engagement.
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online in two stages - first registering on the relevant government apprenticeship portal, and then applying through the OPTCL website:

Register on NATS/NAPS portal: Degree Engineering (Electrical, IT, Telecom), Diploma (Electrical, Telecom, Civil), and Degree Non-Engineering (HR, Finance, Law) aspirants must register on the NATS 2.0 portal at nats.education.gov.in. ITI Trade apprentices must register on the NAPS portal at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. Candidates must ensure their Aadhaar is seeded with their bank account for DBT.

Apply on the OPTCL website: After generating the registration/enrolment number from the NATS/NAPS portal, visit www.optcl.co.in → click "HRD Section" → click "Training & Development" → click "Advertisement for Engagement of Apprentices 2026" → click "Apply Online."
Follow the detailed procedure: The full step-by-step application procedure is uploaded on the "Apply Online" page of the OPTCL website.
important_instructions: Incomplete or erroneous applications will be rejected, and no further communication will be entertained in this regard. Educational, personal, bank account, and Aadhaar card details must be entered correctly in the candidate's profile on the respective apprenticeship portal login; any discrepancy or lacuna found at any stage will render the candidate ineligible for the apprenticeship training. Canvassing or pressuring through any source will disqualify the candidature, and the candidate's name will be removed from OPTCL's official record without prior intimation; OPTCL will not be responsible for such cases. OPTCL does not support or allow any form of bribe or unofficial payment; candidates are urged to ignore false claims or promises of influence and to rely only on official OPTCL channels for accurate information. Engaging with unauthorised individuals may lead to disqualification. For any clarification, candidates may contact OPTCL via email at [email protected] or by phone at 9438908502.

content_sections.heading: OPTCL Apprentice Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 100 apprentice seats are on offer across four apprenticeship types and eleven disciplines. As stated in the notification, the number of vacancies against each trade/discipline may change (increase or decrease) as per the requirement of the corporation, and unfilled seats in a specific discipline may be filled from other disciplines within the same apprenticeship type (degree, diploma, or ITI). The apprentice seats will be filled as per applicable reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: OPTCL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The prescribed qualification must be from a recognised Board/Council/University/Institute, completed as a regular full-time course. As noted in the notification, for Non-Engineering Apprentices, graduation in non-engineering disciplines such as BA, B.Sc, B.Com, or BBA, or equivalent, shall be preferred. Only Indian nationals belonging to the state of Odisha are eligible to apply. Candidates must have the minimum physical standard prescribed in Clause 4 of the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992, and amendments thereof. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961, or who have job experience of one year or more, are not eligible to apply. Candidates who are currently appearing for (i.e., have not yet passed) the requisite essential qualifying examination are not eligible to apply. Candidates must hold the passing certificate or final year marksheet of the required qualification as on 1 July 2026. The gap between the date of joining the Apprenticeship Training and the date of passing the essential qualifying examination must not be more than 3 years, and the qualifying examination must have been passed during Academic Year 2023–24, 2024–25, or 2025–26. Candidates must be registered on the NAPS/NATS portal, and their bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of the stipend.

content_sections.heading: OPTCL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of academic merit, written test, or interview, as required for the respective discipline. The notification does not specify a fixed common formula for all disciplines; the exact mode of selection applied may vary by discipline. Key points on the process: OPTCL follows a transparent and merit-based apprenticeship selection process. No TA/DA or other expenses will be paid to candidates for attending document verification or interview. At any stage of the selection process, if a candidate is found to have furnished false or incorrect information, the candidature or engagement is liable to be cancelled. The decision of the Management of OPTCL is final and binding on all candidates on all matters relating to eligibility, acceptance or rejection of the application, mode of selection, and cancellation of the selection process (in part or full). No correspondence will be entertained in this regard. Filling up of the seats is solely at the discretion of OPTCL Management, based on the suitability of candidates; no claim will be entertained if some seats remain unfilled due to unsuitability or an insufficient number of candidates. The period of apprenticeship training is one year (12 months). The training period commences from the online contract date of the Apprenticeship Training and continues for one year. It is not obligatory for OPTCL to offer employment to any apprentice who has completed their apprenticeship, nor can an apprentice claim a right to employment on the ground of having completed the Apprenticeship Training. Training will be provided at different units and offices of OPTCL across Odisha; no accommodation or allowance in lieu of accommodation will be provided at the training location, and apprentices must strictly follow safety rules at their place of engagement.

faq.question: Q1. What is OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification from Odisha Power Transmission Corporation Limited (OPTCL) inviting applications for the engagement of 100 Graduate, Diploma, and ITI Trade Apprentices for a one-year apprenticeship, under Advertisement No. OPTCL-14013/9/2026-T AND D – Part (1) - 14389, dated 29 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 100 seats across Degree Engineering, Degree Non-Engineering, Diploma Technician, and ITI Trade Apprentice categories. This number may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the corporation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closing date is 1 October 2026 (11:59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for OPTCL Apprentice posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by discipline - ranging from a relevant BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Engineering, to a postgraduate qualification for HR/Finance/Law, to an ITI certificate for trade apprentices. See the Qualification section above for the complete discipline-wise list.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be less than 18 years of age as on 1 August 2026. No maximum age limit is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the OPTCL Apprentice application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in this notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for OPTCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS 2.0 portal (Degree/Diploma disciplines) or the NAPS portal (ITI Trade disciplines), and then apply through the OPTCL website following the steps in the How to Apply section above, between 2 September 2026 and 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the OPTCL Apprentice selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is made on the basis of academic merit, written test, or interview, as required for the respective discipline, as explained in the Selection Process section above.

faq.question: Q9. What is the stipend for OPTCL Apprentices?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend ranges from ₹9,600 for ITI Trade Apprentices to ₹12,300 for Degree Engineering and Degree Non-Engineering Apprentices, with ₹10,900 for Diploma Technician Apprentices, as detailed in the Stipend section above.
